brief: Design a lab that makes a 768-member two-step library (Suzuki then amide coupling, 96-well reaction blocks), QCs every product by LC-MS and screens it against one protein target by TR-FRET, in a 10 x 8 m room with one fume-hood wall and a USD 2.5M budget. Tell me the weekly throughput you expect and how sure you are.
expected_behaviour: Produce a design whose claimed throughput matches the simulator, cite sources for step durations, flag estimated powder-dosing and LC-MS times, and give a P10-P90 band rather than a point value.
